alignment_model.use: Timing only, not replacement transcription. Raw timestamp predictions; upstream timestamp interpolation disabled. Human lexical transcript unchanged.
alignment_model.reference_uncertainty: Estimated boundaries, not human timing verification. Model-predicted zero-length or overlapping spans remain uncertain; invalid out-of-range/reversed spans fail preparation rather than being filled.

ctc_alignment_repair_models.use: Vocabulary-covered monotone CTC forced alignment of unchanged human text only when raw primary predictions are rejected.
Same CTC repair only for segments whose full lexical vocabulary is covered, including Latin letters. Never used for unsupported fillers.
